latest_release.name: v3.8.3
latest_release.body:
更换 hook 方案，大幅提升性能，要求框架实现允许在系统服务中加载原生库
升级到 libxposed API 101
最低支持版本提升至 Android 11
提升应用列表加载速度
新增可按应用单独设置的激进意图过滤选项
优化配置与列表刷新流程
移除 Firebase

Replace the hooking approach to significantly improve performance. Requires framework support for loading native libraries in system services.
Upgrade to libxposed API 101.
Raise the minimum supported version to Android 11.
Improve app list loading speed.
Add an aggressive intent filtering option that can be configured per app.
Optimize the configuration and list refresh flow.
Remove Firebase
